_: What is never captured (R8). Every implementation's exclusion check gives these answers; the reference (src/exclusion.js) and the macOS daemon both test against this file. A capture is excluded when its app is a system app for the platform, or when any self window or user fragment appears, case-insensitively, in its window title or its app name. A user list that exists but cannot be read is not an empty list: nothing is captured until it can be read (fail closed).
